svg.title: Washington wine-growing study atlas
svg.desc: Follow the inland Columbia wine country east of the Cascades, while keeping Puget Sound distinct on the western side. Approximate study locations, not appellation boundaries. Numbers refer to the study key; a shared number connects places in one grouped lesson. 1: Columbia Valley (WA). A large inland region east of the Cascades, extending into northern Oregon; no single dot can show its footprint.

g.text: Dots: representative places · outlines: geography, not appellation boundaries
